tasks.label: Mount NUCLEO
tasks.command: device=$(find /dev/disk/by-id -maxdepth 1 -type l -name 'usb-MBED_microcontroller_*-0:0' -print -quit); if [[ -z "$device" ]]; then echo 'No NUCLEO MBED drive found.' >&2; exit 1; fi; findmnt --noheadings --source "$(readlink -f "$device")" > /dev/null || udisksctl mount -b "$device"
